notes.title: It's Storytime! New DLC available now
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We are super pumped to announce the release of our first Helping the Hotties DLC called Storytime.

Storytime brings four new stories that focus on specific characters from the Helping the Hotties game. Some stories give us flashbacks of the events that happened before the game. Other stories bring what-if moments and explore situations that are not linked to the main story. 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40206348/ac270bafb9fd06f2138937926cf54046daa37c8d.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40206348/ac270bafb9fd06f2138937926cf54046daa37c8d.gif[/img][/url]

The Storytime DLC is translated to all the supported languages and can be synced to Lovense interactive toys for a more immersive experience. The stories also include short voiceover lines that enhance the character dialogues.

But that’s not all! We also added a new translation, 🇧🇷 Brazilian Portuguese 🇧🇷. Now you will be able to enjoy our game with Brazilian Portuguese subtitles. 

Let us know what do you think about our stories.

notes.title: Animation improvements and New Translations update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40206348/4adcabee5d2bf2d2ba76f23ff144dd38d64074e3.jpg[/img]

Hey guys!

As you guys already know, our Helping the Hotties has 🇺🇸 English voice overs, but it is also translated to  🇨🇳 Chinese and 🇹🇷 Turkish thanks to you, our community. 

Since you guys are playing it all around the world and you want to help translate it to other languages, we created a new way to make it happen. With your help we will translate two couples of languages at the time, starting with 🇫🇷 French, 🇮🇹 Italian, 🇵🇱 Polish and 🇷🇺 Russian. 

At the moment they are in different stages of translation, but as soon as one is finished, we will replace it with a new, most requested, language. Since we want for these translations to be the most accurate, we are looking for native speakers, or someone who is fluent in those languages to apply for the roles of translator and proofreader

You can find more info about it on our Discord server:

[url=https://ptb.discord.com/channels/532119654722961408/944184177815846932][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40206348/2c6f00a863b887cfa30f0d26eb84cbb85d6d0cf3.png[/img][/url]


Some of you reported issues with the game once the animations were displayed. Issues like animations lagging and your devices getting loud and hot (just like some of our hotties), so we found what caused the issue and with this update, that issue should be finaly solved. Please hit us up if you'll still be experiencing this or any other issues with the game.

Also, we heard about some of you not enjoying our current ending, so what we decided to do is ask you, our fans, for help. We will have a dedicated channel on our Discord where we will discuss how to improve it so it makes sense, and if we find a solution that will make the game better, we will do it.

Thank you again for your feedback and for your support!

Cheers!

Hey everyone,

We’ve got some big news today! This is probably the most important update after our game launch. We partnered up with one of the biggest toy-makers in the world, Lovense, and we took it to the next level. Connect any Lovense toy to the Lovense Remote App, enable the Game mode and immerse yourselves in the most amazing scenes! Lovense interactive toys are bringing even more pleasure to your experience. notes.title: Helping the Hotties 1.0 is OUT!
notes.content:
[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/bc361e240afd1ecb739c2a55b7076c67/93ef8020853d794b-3b/s2048x3072/49d90f80ed676207cff84886820c9be2787145a0.jpg[/img]

We made it!

You and us, we made it. After more than 20 000 work hours spent crafting the story and all of the different story paths, creating fantastic renders and breathtaking animations all rendered in fantastic 4K, adding features like different voiceovers (5 different actors), music focused on the current mood and sound effects emphasizing what is going on in the game. Missions and Achievements, interactive walkthrough, and many many testing and bug fixing, so you can play them on your favorite PC, Mac or Linux.


[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/71b506eacd7dabb7ef532467fa8ebdc0/e6ada475c072bb6e-77/s2048x3072/3d5d18fc537e0623e247301789eab761ef14920c.pnj[/img]

It was tough, probably the toughest thing I did in my life. It was so stressful not only on me, but on my incredible team as well, who stayed by my side when it was easy to quit, but they believed in xRed and in the Hotties and I will never forget that.

We never stoped learning and looking for a way to improve the game and experience. Now when I look at the game, there are soo many things I would change just to improve it a little bit, but no, we had to stop otherwise it would never be finished. And don't get me wrong, I am happy where we got with it, but boy was it tough.

[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/7e655f1595a0dcf2f57edc9ab821bccc/e6ada475c072bb6e-d2/s2048x3072/4cd398fc7181b39b7684e1c07766c55dec0ea9dd.pnj[/img]

Of course, nothing would be possible without your incredible support, checking on us if we were slacking or not doing enough, and truly THANK YOU for that.

No slacking, no screwing around. Everything by the book.

We bought more than a thousand different assets, making this game 100% legitimate and not a single piece of software we used for creating this game was pirated. From the tinniest DAZ asset to Adobe and Microsoft software solutions. We respect the community which helps us build this incredible games and we encourage all the other creators, especially big ones to do the same.

[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/cd944858c0577edbc30389ea338fbf52/e6ada475c072bb6e-ac/s2048x3072/fabd3b86a0e0ba45635a4e6cfdf20d4df2e10f36.pnj[/img]
[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/3eb08f99775970846980db1f2a031983/e6ada475c072bb6e-fc/s2048x3072/0586acf927290231c9a6b2f252280fb92588dfca.pnj[/img]

We managed to manually translate more than 70% of the game to Chinese with the help of our Chinese translator and since we were on the tight schedule (and money), the rest was translated using machine translation. In the upcoming weeks we will work on finishing proofreading and  translation and we will update our game accordingly. 

Our plan is to translate it to Turkish, Portuguese – Brazilian, Spanish and other languages first by machine translation and with yours help profread it so it's correct. If you would like to help us, please reach out to us on our Discord server. We will create a dedicated hub for everyone and I will have more info about it soon.

[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/79b1177a799f651727d49863e8dd889d/e6ada475c072bb6e-33/s2048x3072/8c40fd82505d6fb0556559e2c991e2ae8a940077.jpg[/img]
[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/e630e878c99d491baf4ff35e9f7d8805/e6ada475c072bb6e-26/s2048x3072/e5cc6d0d9b505e2fb2baad0e5527c27302655287.pnj[/img]
First time here? Don't worry, try a get a Helping the Hotties Free Demo on Steam

Join our community on Discord!

notes.title: Helping the Hotties - Progress Update
notes.content:
Hey, everyone!

Because there have been quite a few questions regarding the new Helping the Hotties update, we have decided to create this post with all the important information. During these past few months, we have been developing the new update and it is almost ready!

And if you have been wondering about what we have been working on… 

Before anything else, we have been focused on continuing the main story of the adult visual novel and further developing the stories of individual characters. As always, there are different paths of the story determined by your decisions and different opportunities to connect with the characters and discover new things about them. 

There is a lot that you are about to learn.

And let’s not forget about features like animations, voiceovers, collectibles and achievements. Although the voiceover feature has been put on hold for the time being, we have been working hard on adding the other features. Along with that, we have been fixing bugs and adjusting things as needed. 

Don’t want to leave a stone unturned!

But in addition to all that, we have been listening to your feedback and have decided to create a new design for the walkthrough to make it more convenient to use and help you better understand the consequences of your decisions, particularly when it comes to deciding which character to develop a relationship with and which path to choose. 

And here is the current plan…

After we are done with all the testing for the new update, the finished update will be released here on Steam, completely free of charge. Although the release date is yet to be determined, you can expect the update to be here by the end of June. 

Are you interested in other update reports, posts talking about what’s new and joining different discussions? Then check out our Discord and Twitter. 

Here is our Discord: https://discord.gg/PwmY9mwBFs 
This is our Twitter: https://twitter.com/xRedGamess 

Also, please do not hesitate to leave us feedback down in the comments!

What are your favorite features of this adult visual novel? 
Do you have a favorite character and scene from one of the previous updates?

notes.title: Red Falls has become Helping the Hotties!
notes.content:
[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/c1e5687f6a8c3711f5f5e34aa6ed35c2/9525be0097023a9f-89/s2048x3072/43614046c2bbfdd36356a9d1764041070ab9f41a.jpg[/img]

Hey guys! We have a special announcement to make. Remember the surprise we hinted at? It’s finally here!

We listened to your feedback and took your suggestions to heart, fundamentally rebuilding the narrative and improving the overall experience. Because of the amount of changes, we realized that this new experience deserved a more fitting name.

That's why we're proud to present our new game, the labor of many months of hard work - Helping The Hotties - a harem game where you play as the only male character in a camp full of curious, seductive, ladies. Will you find the right one for you or will you be able to handle all of them? Play the game to find out!

We want to give you the best experience possible, so here are some of the new features that have been implemented:

[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/b8b3443c0fa73b6a940d43919ae5fcd4/6b73fea0afed4b47-75/s2048x3072/9cc5749ccc71eaa3311cbb3c941357de7837f58e.pnj[/img]

NEW Visuals

All the original and new renders have been rebuilt from the ground up, re-rendered specifically to improve the visual fidelity of the game. All our focus went into the attention to detail needed to improve all renders and enhance the game's atmosphere with improved lighting and textures, and we hope you'll enjoy the huge improvement.

[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/f397c270c854fce9bde0664396f601b4/682648007ccc7650-62/s2048x3072/36f1d6ed676478d75ccc5cfb0a092998de7b6bd0.pnj[/img]

Mini-Games

If you’re feeling extra playful, try out some mini-games to play the scenes out in a more unconventional manner. If mini-games aren't your cup of tea, you can turn them on or off in the menu at any time.

[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/f0c971143ee3a62ebc4ce91189041d5c/1e86e1969476473c-8c/s2048x3072/ef240a26c560e69e8218ad1e260d4bd16ba1a1e1.pnj[/img]

Free Roam Mode vs. Visual Novel Mode

Another big feature we've added that changes the way it feels to play the game is a free roam mode toggle. If the sandbox type experience isn't how you like to play, and experience our games, then you can turn off free roam mode at any time from the menu–changing all free roam segments into multiple choice buttons that will skip past all the walking across camp.

[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/830963f59f46afe5b9906b653b9d4197/520b31ef1df6951f-42/s2048x3072/06bb5aca1d756760236b59a2ac2e24d05f8c86c2.pnj[/img]

Missions and Achievements

How attentive are you to your favorite character? Are you a good guy, or a bad guy? Complete all story missions to enjoy the rewards of your efforts. During the game, you’ll be making decisions which affect story outcomes and directly affect the achievements earned throughout the game. You decide what type of player you want to be, and unlock some hidden renders and animations.

[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/0ced8af5e2223ffaac96f559ee9b08aa/436213f2316babcc-ea/s2048x3072/99dc788ff077228c5bc6427a9f57160e92f3bb60.pnj[/img]

In-Game Collectibles

Wanting to make the game a truly layered experience, we've added collectibles, in the form of panties, to the game! Of course we added panties! What else would you be collecting?Are you an expert panty raider, a completionist, or all of the above? Then you'll definitely find the in-game collectibles to be a welcome addition to your game, and be rewarded with special gallery image for each pantie you find.

Sounds and Music

Sound effects, as well as music, have been added throughout the whole game to make it into a more enjoyable experience. Maybe you'll even find something more than sounds and music we've been working on.

User Interface

New and improved interface to better suit the game’s theme and optimize player experience. It’s a fresh-looking, modern, just like our girls.

Other Technical Features

Apart from these major changes, many more smaller features have been implemented and more will come with each next update. We hope you like it as much as we do!

Bug Reporting System

Sure, it's not a part of the game itself, but to create a great, bug-free game, we need to have a system that will help us solve all the issues even faster. As we want to give you the best gaming experience, even with the game still in development, we take long and detailed testing of our games before they come out. For this episode of Helping the Hotties, we managed to prevent more than 300 different bugs from escaping into your playing experience. We are all pasionate gamers and we know how frustrating it is to be interupted in the middle of the game and then wait for some sort of a fix for a game that was supposedly ready for release. I hope I didn't just jinxed myself, but even if I did, be sure we will fix the problem as soon as you report it and we will release an update right away, so you can continue where you left off.

[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/784ca55c9cf30938bf387c90682d35ab/2843c3b0a158172c-c8/s640x960/5e33452a2c8d86bf87fc3821825580ce9b0b06c6.pnj[/img]

We've created multiple new channels for you to report any bugs you may find while playing the game. One of these new systems is a bug reporting (ticketing) system, integrated into our Discord server, while another is the support page of our new website which should be fixed in the coming days! You can still use Patreon to report bugs, or message us directly, and we'll do our best to help make your experience better.

Lastly, check out our new webpage for all the latest info: [url=http://xred.games]www.xred.games [/url]

This is just the beginning of a long and exciting journey we’re embarking on. We’re very grateful you’re here with us, and hope you'll join us in our next steps to making your gaming experience better than ever.

Are you still here? GO PLAY THE GAME! 

Cheers!

xRed Games team

notes.title: Episode 6 update is LIVE!
notes.content:
-- please run "Verify integrity of game files..." before first start of the game after this update

Hey guys,

Red Falls episode 6 is finally out! 

We have worked hard during these last couple of months to bring you, once again, the biggest update we've ever produced! We listened to your feedback and this is the first step (out of many) where we introduce the changes to Red Falls.


The Story
The story picks up when, at your most vulnerable, someone was watching. You think it was Emily, but it was too dark to tell. Jumping out of bed, driven by your detective instincts, you know what you must do. It's time to unmask the mysterious Forest Sucker, and resolve this nonsense once and for all!
As shown in one of the previous posts, the branching in episode 6 is bigger and more robust than in any of our previous releases.

The Sound
In terms of technical improvements, we have added sound effects throughout the whole game, and we will be adding music and some other sounds later on.

The Visual
Visual effects have been added and improved (sunscreen, water effects, etc.), as well as removing clipping and other visual defects found in previous episodes.

The Gameplay
Some structural changes have been implemented in the entire game (friendship and romantic relations, change of character's name), so from now on, you'll only be asked for your name and not for relationship status between the characters. 
The demo sequence from the pre-main menu screen has been moved to the start new game screen to make it more intuitive.
Unfortunately it is possible that some of your old saves won't work as expected. The game is still in development and we are, and will be, making big changes before the whole season is done.

The whole team is excited to bring you this episode and we all thank you for your support!

Feel free to join our Discord server where we can discuss Red Falls, Lewd Island and more...

Cheers and enjoy!
